raw_segments.text: He looked down at the boots he had blacked and polished.
She had outlived him, lost her husband, more dead for her than for me.
One must outlive the other, wise men say.
There are more women than men in the world, condole with her, your terrible loss.
I hope you'll soon follow him, for Hindu widows only.
